pressure_hypothesis.title: Compact ECI hides identities of observed ambient services
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability intelligence service accountability
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The compact ECI response reported seven scheduler decisions but returned one owner-pass observation and omitted six detailed rows, so the selected response did not identify the other observed Environment services.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve a bounded per-owner summary of recorded scheduler decisions through response compaction, with source coverage explicit and agent opportunity, fulfillment, receipt, and intervention burden left unmeasured unless evidence establishes them.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one selected campaign-window response; recurrence across response shapes or sessions is not established
not_measured: agent time or tool calls caused by omitted owner-pass identities
whether any omitted owner was relevant to an agent need
frequency of owner-summary omission across other evidence windows
whether omission changed a development decision

measurement_limits: Six omitted rows do not establish six distinct owner services or that any service was absent; only the returned detailed owner identity is asserted.
Scheduler decision coverage is not an agent-opportunity denominator and does not establish service fulfillment, correctness, receipt, or reduced intervention burden.
The selected ECI response was partial and response-truncated; recurrence and causal impact are not established.
